name: Mosaic Screen: KOT Board
describe: mosaic KOT board for one production unit, masonry result pre-computed statically as 4 columns of 256+24 cards.

Opened from a production card. masonry-layout positions are computed in JS in the source; this mock fixes the column pitch at 284px (282px card + 2px). Arabic item and waiter names are sample translations. Modes: light and rtl only; dark is not applicable (mosaic defines one light palette).
